decisions.reason: The accepted connector distribution concerns the new integrated board, not the independently specified layout of the previous main board.
The source concerns connector placement on the integrated board and does not alter the previous sensor-board orientation, alignment, or component-placement rules.
The source accepts a connector arrangement for the single integrated board and does not change the separate power-board mechanical layout.
Connector-edge placement does not change the integrated board's cost, sourcing, or connector-reduction requirements.
The source grants mechanical placement flexibility but does not alter the required light-sensor connector's quantity, type, interface, or purpose.
The reference to having one board is consistent with the existing architecture and introduces no change to its consolidation or functionality-preservation state.
The decision concerns where connectors may be placed, not whether connectors use through-hole assembly.
Although J_DISP_LED is among the mechanically constrained connectors, the source does not change the backlight circuit, supply, control, or component requirements.
The antenna-related mechanical constraint does not alter the ESP32 breakout pin-header pitch.
Connector placement has no necessary effect on charging behavior, required rails, battery efficiency, or the selected power-management component.
The mechanical connector-layout decision does not change the required current-measurement capability or conditional omission of the INA device.
The source concerns placement of connectors on the integrated board, while this Requirement governs the separate power board's USB-C type, data lines, and sourceability.
